post.summary: Replace the active theme with a newer package of the same id and refresh rendering without restart (theme.write + theme.activate). Body: raw ZIP (optional ?expected_generation=N) or JSON {package_ref, expected_generation}.

Install a .pcTheme package (theme.write). Body: JSON {download_url} (repository artifact), JSON {package_ref} (package uploaded by this actor) or the raw package as application/octet-stream. Installs a candidate; never activates. The renderDir theme can never be overwritten.
Activate a validated installed theme and switch live rendering (theme.activate)
